response.sql: WITH member_major_counts AS (SELECT m.major_id, m.department, COUNT(mem.member_id) as member_count FROM major m LEFT JOIN member mem ON m.major_id = mem.link_to_major WHERE mem.member_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.major_id, m.department), major_shares AS (SELECT mmc.major_id, mmc.department, mmc.member_count, CAST(mmc.member_count AS FLOAT) / SUM(mmc.member_count) OVER (PARTITION BY mmc.department) as share FROM member_major_counts mmc), dept_avg_shares AS (SELECT department, AVG(share) as avg_share FROM major_shares GROUP BY department) SELECT ms.major_id, ms.department, ms.member_count, ms.share, ms.share - das.avg_share as difference FROM major_shares ms JOIN dept_avg_shares das ON ms.department = das.department WHERE ms.share > das.avg_share ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
